=== About Me ===

I am a resident  of the northeastern United States  and have been using Ubuntu /Linux  since 2010. My studies in sociology and anthropology were completed in 2016.The majority of my work experience is in commercial electronics manufacturing, producing and testing various assemblies.I also have many hobbies and some include biking , computers, playing guitar, and recording original music.

=== Contributions ===

My Ubuntu journey began after I read a review of Ubuntu 9.10 and installed via wubi which was developed install Ubuntu inside a Windows partition. I quickly moved to a traditional dual boot system. One day while visiting Ubuntu Forums I decided to leave the community cafe and start assisting users in support sub-forums which has become an almost daily practice that I wish to continue as time resources  allow.In 2013 or so I became a Ubuntu Member and later a forum moderator and now have the same role on Ubuntu Discourse.  

Along the way, there has been involvement in testing and some bug reporting of most Ubuntu releases since 9.10. My contributions have been sustained and always well intended. I really enjoy assisting new Ubuntu users as much as I can. The goal is provide answers and information about the Ubuntu operating system in general. To write that I have learned through helping others is an understatement! My ever increasing   knowledge of Linux and sense of community are extremely rewarding.            

=== Future Goals ===

Future goals include  increasing my knowledge of Ubuntu /Linux with the help of Ubuntu community members, documentation, and experience.It is my goal to improve my ability to help others within to forum community and beyond. l continue to spread Ubuntu awareness as opportunities arise.
